+package ext
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+// Authentication method names accepted by flipt.is_auth_method. Keep the values
+// tied to the generated protocol enum so policy labels follow auth.proto.
+var authMethods = map[string]auth.Method{
+	"token":      auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
+	"oidc":       auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC,
+	"kubernetes": auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"k8s":        auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"github":     auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB,
+	"jwt":        auth.Method_METHOD_JWT,
+	"cloud":      auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD,
+}
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name: "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Decl: types.NewFunction(
+			types.Args(types.NewObject(nil, types.NewDynamicProperty(types.S, types.A)), types.S),
+			types.B,
+		),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	authentication := input.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	name, ok := key.Value.(ast.String)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %v", key.Value)
+	}
+	method, ok := authMethods[string(name)]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", string(name))
+	}
+
+	actual := authentication.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(actual != nil && actual.Equal(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(method)))), nil
+}

+package ext
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	for name, method := range authMethods {
+		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Contains(t, auth.Method_name, int32(method))
+			input := ast.ObjectTerm(ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("authentication"),
+				ast.ObjectTerm(ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("method"), ast.IntNumberTerm(int(method))))))
+			result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm(name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(true), result)
+
+			other := ast.ObjectTerm(ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("authentication"),
+				ast.ObjectTerm(ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("method"), ast.IntNumberTerm(0)))))
+			result, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, other, ast.StringTerm(name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(false), result)
+		})
+	}
+	require.Equal(t, authMethods["kubernetes"], authMethods["k8s"])
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	_, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.ObjectTerm(), ast.StringTerm("jwt"))
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")
+
+	input := ast.ObjectTerm(ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("authentication"), ast.ObjectTerm()))
+	_, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm("unknown"))
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "unsupported auth method: unknown")
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodRegistered(t *testing.T) {
+	for name, method := range authMethods {
+		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			query := rego.New(rego.Query(fmt.Sprintf(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, %q)`, name)), rego.Input(map[string]any{
+				"authentication": map[string]any{"method": int(method)},
+			}))
+			result, err := query.Eval(context.Background())
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Len(t, result, 1)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodMissingAuthenticationInPolicy(t *testing.T) {
+	query := rego.New(
+		rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "jwt")`),
+		rego.Input(map[string]any{}),
+		rego.StrictBuiltinErrors(true),
+	)
+	_, err := query.Eval(context.Background())
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "no authentication found")
+}

+func TestEngine_IsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	defer cancel()
+
+	policy := `package flipt.authz.v1
+import rego.v1
+default allow := false
+allow if {
+	input.authentication.metadata.role == "admin"
+	flipt.is_auth_method(input, input.expected_method)
+}`
+	engine, err := newEngine(ctx, zaptest.NewLogger(t), withPolicySource(policySource(policy)))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		name    string
+		input   map[string]any
+		allowed bool
+		err     string
+	}{
+		{"admin with jwt", map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": 5, "metadata": map[string]any{"role": "admin"}}, "expected_method": "jwt"}, true, ""},
+		{"admin with wrong method", map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": 1, "metadata": map[string]any{"role": "admin"}}, "expected_method": "jwt"}, false, ""},
+		{"viewer with jwt", map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": 5, "metadata": map[string]any{"role": "viewer"}}, "expected_method": "jwt"}, false, ""},
+		{"unsupported method", map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": 5, "metadata": map[string]any{"role": "admin"}}, "expected_method": "invalid"}, false, "unsupported auth method: invalid"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			allowed, err := engine.IsAllowed(ctx, tt.input)
+			if tt.err != "" {
+				require.ErrorContains(t, err, tt.err)
+			} else {
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				require.Equal(t, tt.allowed, allowed)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
